TREATMENT OF MYIASIS
Treatment Goals
- Extract the maggot
- Treat or prevent bacterial infection
Non-drug Treatment
- Apply petrolatum: the maggot crawls out to avoid asphyxiation
Or:
- Extract the maggot by compressing simultaneously from beneath on both
sides with a pair of spatulae
Drug Treatment
- Prevent bacterial infection with oral antibiotics if lesions are multiple
- Wound myiasis is flushed out surgically with antiseptics: surgical
debridement
Prevention
- Iron clothes that are dried in the open air
